title: Program Verification and Refinement Stack
summary: Build a Z3-based verification stack in Python under /workspace. This task has three layers that genuinely depend on each other: a Boogie verifier, a Dafny-to-Boogie verification pipeline, and an IronFleet-style distributed lock service proof.
instructionPreview: Build a Z3-based verification stack in Python under /workspace.
instruction:
Build a Z3-based verification stack in Python under `/workspace`. This task has
three layers that genuinely depend on each other: a Boogie verifier, a
Dafny-to-Boogie verification pipeline, and an IronFleet-style distributed lock
service proof.

Implement them in this order:

`boogie_verifier.py`
Build a usable BoogiePL verifier with the full typed AST, parser, weakest-
precondition and VC generation pipeline, SSA-aware procedure verification,
loop handling with invariants, SMT/Z3 encoding, counterexamples, and
verification diagnostics. It must verify the programs in
`test_programs/boogie/`.

`dafny_translator.py`
Build a Dafny front end and verifier that can parse the richer Dafny language,
check types and termination, handle refinement and induction machinery, lower
Dafny constructs into Boogie, and then verify the result with Z3 and
path-sensitive VC generation. It must verify the programs in
`test_programs/dafny/`.

`ironfleet_lock.py`
Model and verify a distributed lock service using layered refinement: protocol
and specification state machines, safety invariants, abstraction mapping,
forward simulation, bounded liveness/fairness reasoning, and a multi-host
network model checked with Z3 bounded model checking for three nodes.

Keep the implementation focused on end-to-end verification rather than on
isolated parsers. The deliverable is a working stack that passes
`pytest /tests/{boogie,dafny,ironfleet}/` and whose per-module `run.sh`
scripts emit the required `KEY: VALUE` experiment lines. Use the files in
`requirements/` as the source of truth for exact contracts and metrics.

moduleDag.description: A three-layer program verification stack inspired by the Boogie/Dafny/IronFleet tool chain from Microsoft Research. The stack implements: (1) a BoogiePL intermediate verification language with weakest-precondition VC generation, (2) a Dafny-like high-level verification language that translates to BoogiePL, and (3) a distributed lock service verified using IronFleet's layered refinement methodology.

nodes.label: Boogie: BoogiePL Verifier
nodes.description: Complete BoogiePL intermediate verification language implementation including: full type system (Int/Bool/Bitvec/Map/UserDefined), typed AST hierarchy (Program/Procedure/Implementation/BasicBlock/Cmd/Expr), tokenizer, recursive-descent parser, WP transformer (assign/assert/assume/havoc/call/ array-store), VC generator with SSA conversion and loop handling (back-edge detection, invariant injection, cut-points), procedure verifier with modular contracts, SMT encoder (Z3 integration + SMT-LIB2 output), counterexample extraction, verification diagnostics, trigger selection heuristics, CFG analysis (dominators, natural loops, critical edges), and loop invariant inference.

nodes.label: Dafny: Program Verifier
nodes.description: Full Dafny auto-active verifier implementation including: rich type system (Int/Nat/Bool/Real/Array/Seq/Set/Map/Datatype/Class/SubsetType/NewType), complete AST (Module/Class/Datatype/Method/Function/Lemma/Predicate, Statement hierarchy, Expression hierarchy with quantifiers and match), tokenizer with keyword recognition, recursive-descent parser, termination checker (decreases clauses, structural decrease, lexicographic tuples), automatic induction engine (detect inductive args, hypothesis generation), refinement checker (abstract→concrete module, signature compatibility), Boogie compiler (method→procedure, function→axiom, datatype→discriminator, loop desugaring to basic blocks, ghost erasure), type checker with inference, Z3-based verification with path-sensitive VC generation, and diagnostics.

nodes.label: IronFleet: Distributed System Verification
nodes.description: Complete IronFleet-style distributed lock service verification including: protocol state machine (State/Action/Init/Next), safety invariants (mutual exclusion, epoch agreement, message invariant, epoch monotonicity), host implementation with IO actions, specification state machine, abstraction function (refinement mapping), forward simulation proof, liveness proof with ranking function, system composition (multi-host with shared network), extended network model (duplication/reordering/dropping), environment model with fairness, temporal reasoning (bounded liveness, progress verification), invariant decomposition (local/network/cross-host), fairness checking (WF/deadlock-freedom), multi-step refinement, and epoch monotonicity proofs.

edges.label: Dafny compiles to Boogie as its verification backend
IronFleet uses Dafny to verify distributed system implementations
